title: Pin Chute Windows 2.6.1 RC1 as recovery precedent
context: Owner observed excellent long-term Chute continuity and requested replicable cold-agent inheritance.
decision: Preserve documented purpose, tested native messaging wake-and-relaunch behavior and exact source/release pin from Chute Windows v2.6.1 RC1; independently implement under ATLAS security and licensing constraints.
rationale: A future agent must understand which operational outcome mattered and its evidence even if the historical code is unavailable or replaced.

provenance.sourceReference: Owner companion recovery design 2026-10-15; Chute Windows v2.6.1 RC1 historical reference
